shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets Plummet: Bitcoin fell below $80K, ETH below $2,300; market sentiment hit panic levels.
Fed Decision & Inflation Loom: US Fed rate decision, inflation, and Q3 GDP data this week, increasing market uncertainty.
Geopolitical Tensions Rise: Middle East escalation and $117 oil fuel inflation fears, pressuring risk assets.
Ethereum Upgrade Postponed: "Glamsterdam" upgrade delayed due to security concerns, removing a key catalyst.
Institutional Outflows: Bitcoin ETFs saw over $773M outflows; $150M+ crypto liquidations.
